The warm reads of both arms follow, then the remaining cold reads"; a cold roadmap cannot be produced without its warm roadmap in the same invocation, so "the warm reads of both arms follow" the cold roadmaps and the "remaining cold reads" precede their own warm reads — the phase split the sentence describes is not producible by the named profiler, and a worker bound by this node's "exact — implement as written" spec cannot satisfy it
